experiment: Direct direction-probability head versus archived executable-return MSE20
scope: Exploratory test on the same repeatedly inspected 141 validation Fridays in 2018-2020. No new market data, full-paper-replication, independent-confirmation, trading-profitability or deployment claim.
architecture: Same original combined backbone, geometry and auxiliary head, 38551 parameters and dropout0.3. Reuse the existing Linear25-to-1 return_head tensor layout as an UP LOGIT, not as a standardized return. Backbone architecture and seed initialization remain identical; all parameters remain trainable. This is end-to-end training from initialization, not a frozen-backbone linear probe or fine-tuning of a selected old state.
initialization: Zero direction-head weights. Set its bias to logit(training_up_frequency), using only this fold's completed raw return labels, frequency clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]. This gives the classifier its causal constant-probability initialization, analogous to the old return model's training-mean initialization. Bias assignment consumes no RNG and is the only changed initial tensor; log the shared-tensor fingerprint and initial states.
targets: Direction=1 iff the RAW executable return is strictly greater than zero; zero or negative return is class0. Never threshold a standardized return. Training masks remain joint_completed<=cutoff so both return and auxiliary labels have matured. Original training counts1678,1921,2165; Friday validation masks49,46,46 remain unchanged. Retain original invalid-OHLC exclusions and raw OHLCV feature caches.
objective: Unweighted binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logit,raw_return>0), mean reduction, plus0.1 times original standardized auxiliary OHLCV all-element MSE. No class weights, label smoothing, loss rescaling, additional return loss or auxiliary ablation. Auxiliary normalization, AdamW, sample permutations, gradient clipping and physical batch sizes match the original MSE20 setup. BCE has a different scale/gradient from standardized-return MSE, so keeping the nominal auxiliary weight does not isolate all multitask gradient effects.
budget: Exactly9 new fits=3cutoffs*3seeds,20epochs each=180actualepochs,2820optimizer updates,345840sample presentations. Reuse9 original MSE20 checkpoints and423 old seed predictions. No best-seed choice, intermediate validation, early stopping, epoch search or second classifier variant.
probabilities: Convert float32 logits to float64 probabilities with exp(-logaddexp(0,-logit)); average the three seed PROBABILITIES, not logits. Direction is strictly p>0.5, including for the training-frequency and neutral0.5 references. Neutral0.5 therefore has a deterministic non-up tie decision, not a sampled random decision. Original MSE20 uses the sign of its equal-weight mean raw return, as before.
probability_metrics: Brier=mean((p-y_binary)^2); log_loss=mean(-y*log(p)-(1-y)*log(1-p)), probabilities clipped to[1e-12,1-1e-12] for reported probability log loss only. Report clip counts. Original return predictions are not probabilities: Brier/log_loss/calibration are unavailable for that comparator, and no arbitrary sigmoid or fitted calibration is applied to it. Raw return MSE and binary Brier are different metrics and must not be compared numerically.

training_diagnostics.description: At each final state evaluate direction log loss/Brier/accuracy and auxiliary/joint losses with dropout off and8fixed dropout draws. Save and protect model, CPU/CUDA RNG and training modes during diagnostics. Compare to this fold's training-frequency probability. Record all180online epoch losses/orders/boundaries and final optimizer/RNG states. No validation tensors or labels enter fits or training diagnostics; immutable file hashes may be read for auditing.

validation_diagnostics: Report ensemble/year/seed direction accuracy, correct counts, balanced accuracy, confusion counts, predicted-up fraction and AUROC. Probability methods additionally report Brier, log loss, probability SD, mean probability, observed frequency and calibration gap. Five fixed equal-width[0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1] reliability bins are descriptive only; retain empty bins. No temperature calibration, threshold fitting or confidence filtering.
inference: Four prespecified paired ensemble comparisons, all expressed as candidate loss minus reference loss (negative is better). Circular8-observation blocks,10000replicates,seed20260910,centered two-sided p; Holm over the complete mixed-metric family of four. Percentile95% intervals are descriptive. Same data and overlapping annual fits/seeds do not constitute independent replications. Historical selection across rounds and neural fitting uncertainty are not accounted for by these fixed-prediction bootstrap tests.
descriptive_screen: Predeclared candidate direction_bce. All8flags required: ensemble accuracy beats original and training-frequency decision; ensemble Brier and log_loss both beat training frequency; at least2/3matched seeds beat original accuracy; at least2/3seeds beat training-frequency Brier; at least2/3years beat original accuracy; at least2/3years beat training-frequency Brier. Report ties as not passing, all seed/year results, no automatic promotion or replacement candidate.
verification: Freeze protocol/core source/input/caches and2415previous evidence files before fitting. Contract-test raw-label sign, causal masks/scales, original shared initialization, probability-mean ensembling, stable BCE formula/gradient, and real-model update/audit isolation. Replay9new classifier states and9old regression states,81final training-loss passes,180epoch orders/batches and optimizer/RNG counters,423classifier logits/probabilities and423archived returns. Independently check ensemble rules, directions, baselines, probability metrics/confusions/reliability bins and four bootstrap comparisons. Preserve all prior artifacts.
